title: SideCharacter's Forever World
description:
Modpack required to play on Side Character's forever world.

It has a heavy focus on Create and Cobblemon and tries to maintain the feeling of Vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# Side Character's Forever World Modpack!
Used to join Side Character's forever world server

## Main Content mods
- Cobblemon
- Create
- Farmer's Delight
- Umapyoi (cause why not :P)
- Addons supporting Cobblemon, Create, Farmer's Delight
- Many other mods supporting the Vanilla experience such as Quartz, Supplementaries and Vista
- Building tool mods to allow you build with any skill level
